Heap sort repeatedly removes the largest element from a heap; counting sort counts keys
from a bounded integer range.
Heap sort එක heap එකක් භාවිතෙ කර values order කරනවා. Counting sort එක key range එක Jපාඩි නම් count array එකක් භාවිතෙ කරනවා. Range එක Jගාඩක් විශාල නම් memory වුඩි Jවනවා.
Sort small-range exam marks or general comparable records.

[1,2,3,3]; counting O(n+k) time and O(k) space for range k. Standard in-place heapsort O(n
log n) worst time, O(1) auxiliary space.
When is counting sort a poor choice?
When the key range is huge relative to the number of items.
